proposal: control-flow layer for the activity graph (lens 'discovery-all')
proposedAs: result.routines — a sibling of result.phases/edges/artifacts. Routines are CONTROL nodes: they say when/why phases run, not what data they exchange. Phase references are id-threaded like edges (phaseId + display name). Every routine carries verbatim evidence per the edges-need-evidence policy, an era validity window (cadences changed between the class era and the summer era, so unversioned cadences would read as contradictions), and a dataSignal line stating the corroborating date-pattern statistic where one exists.

triggerTypes.clock: a cron or fixed time-of-day starts the work

triggerTypes.quota: a standing output quota (N per period) drives the work
triggerTypes.deadline-pull: a downstream fixed deadline pulls upstream work into existence

routines.cadence: goal: 1 release/day (stated 2026-06-24); observed: card-driven, roughly one study per week in July
routines.correction: An earlier draft presented this as an operating 'Daily Study Loop' fired by a 09:00 cron. The D/O/L record refutes that: (a) 2026-07-03 meeting decision — 'The team will continue executing humor studies using manual processes when automation is not available'; (b) the same DM thread that stated the goal reports a zero-study week on 2026-07-07 ('I didn't make a study for the entirety of last week'); (c) releases were one Linear card per study — HP-1147 (jul 8–10), HP-1175 (jul 12–30, 18 days), HP-1227 (jul 22–27), HP-1279 (aug 5) — not cron-fired. The 09:00 cron (set up 6/24) automated study CREATION, and release automation was still being designed on 7/09.

routines.successor: The daily goal's successor cadence IS in the record: HP-1144 'Release a new humor study Mon-Wed-Fri' — completed by Tamar.Lando 2026-07-20, ingested as a done-card D/O/L outcome (meta.doneCard, linear-done-cards lane: one row per card, only once its state is done; open/canceled cards never ingested) and placed in the 'Evaluating Captions via the Humor Study' phase. First visible MWF beats: HP-1254 released Mon 8/03, HP-1279 Wed 8/05. Two search-hygiene lessons from initially missing it: (1) match word-form variants — a regex with comma/space separators missed hyphenated 'Mon-Wed-Fri'; claims of absence require variant-robust search; (2) the card LENSES (stale, computed 7/27, cards ≤ HP-1206) are not the graph — done-card chunks are placed directly in phase chunkIds. Cadence-shaped card titles are trigger declarations and reach the D/O/Ls only at completion — a recurring card that never closes stays invisible.

graphAlignment.method: Each routine's consecutive step pairs (phaseId → phaseId) tested against the graph's 19 evidenced edges (fromId/toId/via/confidence); steps anchored to result.children sub-activity nodes where a matching node exists.
graphAlignment.headline: 9 of 18 step-hops ride an evidenced data edge; ALL hops that carry only a start signal (cron fires, bot pings, meeting blesses) have no edge. The graph's missing hops are exactly the control-only ones.
edgeBackedHops: daily-study-goal: AI Pipeline → Humor Study via 'AI-generated captions' (1.0); Humor Study → Synthesis via 'Humor Study results' (1.0)

flavor-cycle: JPEG Assist → AI Pipeline via 'Curated source images' (0.9); Writer's Room → Humor Study via 'Humor Flavor personas/configurations' (1.0); Humor Study → Synthesis via 'Humor Study results' (1.0); Synthesis → Writer's Room via 'Humor insights' (0.7) — the graph closes the weekly cycle itself
friday-release: AI Pipeline → Humor Study via 'AI-generated captions' (1.0); Humor Study → Synthesis via 'Humor Study results' (1.0)
quota: Writer's Room → Humor Study via 'Humor Flavor personas/configurations' (1.0); Humor Study → Publishing via 'Top-performing captions' (0.8)
controlOnlyHops: sub-daily: Sourcing → Analyzing Live Performance (the :02→:04 cron hop) — NO EDGE
daily-study-goal: Project & Course Mgmt → AI Pipeline (card assignment starts the work) — NO EDGE
standup: Internal Admin Tools → Project & Course Management (bot ping) — NO EDGE
flavor-cycle: Writer's Room → JPEG Assist (pick-the-test-set instruction) — NO EDGE; AI Pipeline → Writer's Room (bring captions to internal rating) — NO EDGE

childAnchors: cf-daily-study-goal step 3 → child 'Launch, schedule, and conduct recurring Humor Study sessions' (Humor Study)
cf-daily-sidechat-quota step 3 → child 'Manage the content publishing schedule and posting frequency' (Publishing)

cf-subdaily-ingestion-chain step 1 → child 'Scrape posts from Sidechat, Instagram, and other sources' (Sourcing); infra: 'Implement and manage cron jobs and background job runners' (Backend), 'Build and manage the self-service Cron job system' (Admin Tools)

notCovered: Analyzing Live Performance has NO routine: its evidenced inbound edge (Publishing → Analysis) shows forward median lag 11d with only 13% within 3 days — real inputs, no start signal. This is the canonical 'hard to conceptualize because nothing triggers it' phase; a routine would have to be invented, not discovered.

Event-triggers below routine grain (merge-to-staging → deploy, DB trigger on upvote_count, schema change → regen types) are per-edge control annotations, not cadenced routines — they'd belong on edges as trigger:{type:'event'}, not in result.routines.
